description:
Operating Area: Greece

Elegant Living Spaces and Luxury Accommodation
LETTOULI III offers a refined onboard environment designed to provide comfort, privacy, and relaxation throughout your yacht charter in Greece. The yacht’s interior combines timeless elegance with modern amenities, creating a welcoming atmosphere for guests of all ages.

The main salon is bright and spacious, featuring comfortable seating areas, sophisticated décor, and large windows that fill the interior with natural light while offering panoramic sea views. It is the perfect space to relax, socialize, or enjoy quality time with family and friends while cruising through the Greek Islands.

The dining area provides an elegant setting for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, allowing guests to enjoy freshly prepared meals in complete comfort. Every space onboard has been carefully designed to enhance the luxury yacht charter experience.

Spacious Outdoor Deck Areas
One of the highlights of LETTOULI III Yacht Charter Greece is its generous outdoor living space. Guests can unwind on spacious sunbathing areas, enjoy breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea, or relax with a drink while watching the sunset over the Greek Islands.

The yacht offers inviting outdoor seating and dining areas, ideal for alfresco meals, social gatherings, and unforgettable moments at sea. Whether anchored in a secluded bay or cruising between destinations, the exterior decks provide the perfect balance of comfort and luxury.

Comfortable Guest Accommodation
LETTOULI III features beautifully appointed cabins designed to offer a peaceful and relaxing retreat after a day on the water. The accommodation combines stylish furnishings, practical layouts, and premium finishes to ensure a comfortable stay throughout the charter.

Each cabin provides privacy and convenience, allowing guests to enjoy a restful atmosphere while exploring some of Greece’s most spectacular destinations. The elegant design and attention to detail create a warm and welcoming environment that enhances the overall onboard experience.

Luxury Yacht Charter in Greece
From its stylish interiors to its spacious outdoor areas, LETTOULI III delivers an exceptional luxury yacht charter experience in Greece. Whether you are exploring Mykonos, Santorini, Paros, Milos, or the Ionian Islands, the yacht provides the ideal setting for discovering the beauty of the Mediterranean in comfort and style.

LETTOULI III is an excellent choice for guests seeking a luxury motor yacht charter in Greece, combining elegant living spaces, premium amenities, and professional service for an unforgettable holiday at sea.

crew.name: George Tsourakis
crew.bio:
Professional Profile
With over 20 years of maritime experience, Captain George Tsourakis is a dedicated, highly adaptable leader known for maintaining impeccable operational standards at sea. He excels in complete crew leadership, precision itinerary planning, and decisive crisis management. Thriving under pressure, Captain George consistently delivers exceptional, tailored guest experiences while prioritizing vessel safety, regulatory compliance, and seamless operational efficiency.

Key Competencies:
Leadership & Crew Management: Proven track record in fostering high-performing, safety-conscious team environments.
Navigation & Itinerary Planning: Extensive knowledge of Mediterranean and international waters, crafting memorable charter programs.
Crisis Management & Safety: Expert in emergency response, risk mitigation, and strict adherence to maritime safety protocols.

crew.name: Joyce (Chara) Alafragi
crew.bio:
Professional Profile
Joyce (Chara) Alafragi is an energetic, highly organized Cook/Hostess with a strong commitment to high-end service standards. Known for her positive attitude and meticulous attention to detail, she adapts easily to fast-paced environments on board. Beyond traditional interior stewardship, Chara brings value through her ability to prepare fresh, customized meals, blending hospitality with culinary versatility.

Key Competencies:
Interior Hospitality & Service: Experienced in detail-oriented housekeeping, table settings, and personalized guest care.
Culinary Support: Skilled in preparing fresh, custom menus tailored to dietary preferences.
Organization & Adaptability: Efficient under pressure with strong inventory and guest-flow management skills.

crew.name: Nikolas (Nick) Botsis
crew.bio:
Professional Profile
Following his service in the Greek Navy, Nikolas transitioned into the luxury yachting industry as a disciplined, safety-oriented Deckhand. He is a reliable team player who brings a strong work ethic, rapid adaptability, and keen attention to deck maintenance and tender operations. Eager to continuously expand his maritime knowledge, Nick is actively building his qualifications with a long-term goal of advancing to Captain.

Key Competencies:
Deck Operations & Maintenance: Hands-on experience in surface maintenance, line handling, and tender operations.
Naval Discipline & Safety: Grounded in Greek Navy training with a deep respect for maritime safety protocols.
Professional Growth: Highly motivated, adaptable, and focused on career progression in yacht command.
